continuation_reason: Two measured concurrency levels allow separating fixed GPU memory from buffer growth; test the previously conservatively skipped larger rollout.

skipped.reason: Measured GPU/host memory growth predicts insufficient headroom

initial_probe_failure.reason: NumPy int64 transition count was not JSON serializable; cast to Python int and reran

selection_rule: Lowest peak reserved GPU memory among sizing candidates within 5% of fastest measured throughput; confirmation reported separately.
confirmation_note: Independent confirmation throughput varied from the sizing run; these are short measurements, not a long-run guarantee.
measurement_scope: Two GPUs, one warm-up plus two measured PPO cycles, seed 42, W&B/evaluation/checkpoint writes disabled.
cleanup: Owned probe process groups terminated; TemporaryDirectory removed candidate runs and compiler caches.
